CITY OF RIVERTON — DEPARTMENT OF BUILDINGS

NOTICE TO PERMIT APPLICANTS

Effective July 1, all applications for residential construction permits must be submitted through the city's online portal at riverton.gov/permits. Paper applications will be accepted only by appointment at the City Hall service counter, Room 204. Standard application review takes fifteen business days. Applicants who require faster processing may request expedited review, which is completed within five business days for an additional charge of $150.

Permit fees are calculated at $0.45 per square foot of proposed construction, with a minimum fee of $90. Fees must be paid in full before a permit is issued. Each permit remains valid for 180 days from the date of issuance. A single 90-day extension may be granted if a written request is received before the permit expires; the extension fee is $40.

Questions may be directed to permits@rivertoncity.gov or 555-0142 during regular business hours.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce changes to the permit application process
To advertise a new construction company
To report the closure of City Hall
To invite residents to a public hearing
questions.explanation: 공지의 핵심은 7월 1일부터 주거용 건축 허가 신청이 온라인 포털로 제출되어야 한다는 절차 변경 안내입니다. 수수료, 처리 기간, 유효 기간 등 허가 신청 절차 전반에 대한 변경 및 안내가 주된 내용이므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 건설 회사 광고, 시청 폐쇄, 공청회 초대는 본문에 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: How much would the permit fee be for a 1,200-square-foot construction project?
questions.explanation: 허가 수수료는 제곱피트당 $0.45로 계산됩니다. 1,200제곱피트 × $0.45 = $540이며, 이는 최소 수수료 $90을 초과하므로 그대로 적용됩니다. 따라서 (C) $540이 정답입니다. (D) $690은 신속 처리 수수료 $150을 불필요하게 더한 오답 함정입니다.

questions.question: What is the maximum total period a permit can remain valid if an extension is approved?
options: 90 days
180 days
270 days
360 days
questions.explanation: 허가는 발급일로부터 180일간 유효하며, 만료 전에 서면 요청을 하면 90일 연장이 한 차례 가능합니다. 따라서 최대 유효 기간은 180일 + 90일 = 270일이므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 날짜 계산이 필요한 문제로, 연장은 단 한 번만 허용된다는 점에 유의해야 합니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about expedited review?
options: It is available only for commercial buildings.
It costs an extra $150 and takes five business days.
It requires approval from the city council.
It is free for online applicants.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 신속 처리(expedited review)는 추가 요금 $150를 내면 영업일 기준 5일 이내에 완료된다고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 상업용 건물 한정, 시의회 승인, 온라인 신청자 무료 혜택에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

Application Number: BP-2026-0734
Date Received: June 3
Applicant: Marisol Vega, Vega Home Improvements
Project Address: 88 Calloway Drive
Permit Type: Residential addition (single story)
Application Fee Paid: $310 (credit card)
Assigned Reviewer: D. Okafor

questions.question: What is the applicant asked to do?
options: Pay an additional inspection fee
Submit a missing site plan
Schedule a meeting with the reviewer
Post a permit at the project site
questions.explanation: 양식의 Status 항목에 INCOMPLETE — ACTION REQUIRED라고 표시되어 있고, 부지 경계와 증축 위치를 보여주는 site plan(배치도)이 누락되어 10일 이내에 업로드해야 한다고 안내하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 추가 수수료 납부나 검토자 면담 요청은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: By what date must the missing document be submitted?
options: June 10
June 13
June 18
June 24
questions.explanation: 신청서 접수일이 6월 3일이고, 누락 서류는 접수일로부터 10일(calendar days) 이내에 제출해야 합니다. 6월 3일 + 10일 = 6월 13일이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 달력일 기준이므로 주말을 제외하지 않는다는 점에 유의해야 하는 날짜 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: What will happen if the deadline is missed?
options: The fee will be refunded automatically.
The review period will be extended.
The application will be closed.

questions.question: What is suggested about construction work?
options: It may begin as soon as the fee is paid.
It must not start before the permit is issued.
It must be completed within fifteen days.
It will be supervised by D. Okafor.
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 허가가 발급되어 현장에 게시되기 전까지는 어떤 공사도 시작하지 말라고 명시하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 수수료 납부만으로 착공할 수 있다는 내용은 없으며, 15일은 공사 기한이 아니라 서류 완비 후 심사에 걸리는 기간입니다.

HARTWELL SAVINGS BANK — IMPORTANT ACCOUNT NOTICE

Dear Customers,

Beginning September 1, a $2.00 monthly fee will apply to each checking or savings account that receives a mailed paper statement. Customers who switch to electronic statements will continue to receive their account records at no charge. Electronic statements are posted to online banking on the first business day of each month and are stored for seven years.

The paper statement fee will be automatically waived for account holders aged 65 or older and for all Premium Advantage account holders. No action is needed for customers in these groups.

To avoid the fee, log in to online banking, select Statement Preferences, and choose Electronic Delivery by August 25. Customers who enroll by that date will also be entered into a drawing for one of ten $100 gift cards. If you need assistance with enrollment, please visit any branch or call 555-0188.

Thank you for banking with Hartwell Savings.

questions.question: Why was the notice issued?
options: To announce a fee for mailed paper statements
To introduce a new savings account product
To report a change in branch opening hours
To explain a security breach
questions.explanation: 공지의 첫 문단에서 9월 1일부터 우편 종이 명세서를 받는 계좌에 월 $2.00 수수료가 부과된다고 안내하고 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 신규 상품 소개, 영업시간 변경, 보안 사고는 본문에 등장하지 않습니다.

questions.question: How much would a customer pay in paper statement fees over one full year?
questions.explanation: 종이 명세서 수수료는 월 $2.00이므로 1년(12개월) 동안 부과되는 총액은 $2 × 12 = $24입니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 월 수수료를 연 단위로 환산하는 간단한 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: Who will NOT be charged the fee even without changing their preferences?
options: Customers who opened their account this year
Customers aged 65 or older
Customers with more than one account
Customers who visit a branch monthly
questions.explanation: 본문에 만 65세 이상 계좌 보유자와 Premium Advantage 계좌 보유자는 수수료가 자동 면제되며 별도 조치가 필요 없다고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 신규 고객, 복수 계좌 보유자, 지점 방문 고객에 대한 면제 규정은 없습니다.

questions.question: What additional benefit is offered to customers who enroll by August 25?
options: A higher interest rate
A waiver of all banking fees
Entry into a gift card drawing
A free safe-deposit box
questions.explanation: 8월 25일까지 전자 명세서로 전환하는 고객은 $100 상품권 10장 중 하나를 받을 수 있는 추첨에 응모된다고 안내되어 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 금리 인상, 전체 수수료 면제, 무료 대여금고는 언급되지 않았습니다.

Hartwell Savings Bank
140 Commerce Street, Dalton

June 5

Dear Mr. Reuben Tate,

Our records show that your savings account ending in 4471 has had no deposits, withdrawals, or customer-initiated activity for the past twenty-two months. Under state regulations, an account with no activity for twenty-four consecutive months must be classified as dormant. Dormant accounts are charged a $5.00 monthly maintenance fee, and online access to them is suspended until the account holder visits a branch in person.

Furthermore, if an account remains dormant for an additional twelve months, the bank is required by law to transfer the balance to the state unclaimed property office, after which all claims must be filed with that office rather than with the bank.

Keeping your account active is simple: make a deposit or withdrawal of any amount, or sign in to online banking, by August 15. Any one of these actions will reset the activity record. If you no longer need the account, you may close it at any branch free of charge.

Sincerely,
Priya Raman
Customer Accounts Manager

questions.question: Why did Ms. Raman write the letter?
options: To warn a customer that his account may become dormant
To confirm that an account has been closed
To offer a customer a loan with a low interest rate
To request repayment of an overdrawn balance
questions.explanation: 편지의 목적은 22개월간 거래가 없는 계좌가 24개월이 되면 휴면(dormant) 계좌로 분류된다는 사실을 알리고, 8월 15일까지 거래를 하여 이를 방지하도록 안내하는 것입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 계좌 해지 확인, 대출 제안, 마이너스 잔액 상환 요청은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: According to the letter, what happens when an account is classified as dormant?
options: The account is immediately closed.
A monthly fee is charged and online access is suspended.
The interest rate is reduced to zero.
The balance is donated to charity.
questions.explanation: 휴면 계좌로 분류되면 월 $5.00의 관리 수수료가 부과되고, 계좌 소유자가 지점을 직접 방문할 때까지 온라인 접근이 정지된다고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 즉시 해지되거나 잔액이 기부되는 것이 아니며, 금리에 대한 언급도 없습니다.

questions.question: How can Mr. Tate prevent his account from becoming dormant?
options: By writing a letter to the state office
By paying a $5.00 reactivation fee
By making any transaction or logging in by August 15
By opening a second account at the bank
questions.explanation: 편지 후반부에서 8월 15일까지 금액에 상관없이 입금 또는 출금을 하거나 온라인 뱅킹에 로그인하면 활동 기록이 갱신되어 휴면 처리를 막을 수 있다고 안내하고 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 주 정부 기관에 편지를 쓰거나 수수료를 내는 방법은 제시되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What can be inferred about funds transferred to the state unclaimed property office?
options: They can no longer be recovered by the owner.
They must be claimed through the state office, not the bank.
They are returned to the bank after one year.
They earn a higher interest rate.
questions.explanation: 잔액이 주 미수령 재산 관리소(state unclaimed property office)로 이관된 후에는 모든 청구를 은행이 아닌 해당 기관에 제기해야 한다고 명시되어 있습니다. 즉 돈을 영영 찾을 수 없는 것이 아니라 청구 창구가 바뀌는 것이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

GLENFIELD POST OFFICE — SERVICE CHANGES

Please note the following changes, which take effect Monday, October 6.

Postage rates: The price of a standard first-class stamp will increase from $0.68 to $0.73. The rate for postcards will rise from $0.53 to $0.56. Customers may purchase stamps at current prices until October 5; stamps marked FOREVER remain valid regardless of future rate changes.

Collection times: The final weekday mail collection from the lobby boxes will move from 6:00 P.M. to 5:30 P.M. Saturday collection remains at noon.

Window hours: Saturday counter service will be shortened to 9:00 A.M.–1:00 P.M. Weekday hours are unchanged.

Passport services: Beginning October 6, passport applications will be accepted by appointment only. Appointments can be booked at glenfieldpost.gov/passport or by calling 555-0119.

We appreciate your understanding as we adjust our services to current mail volumes.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce the permanent closure of a post office
To describe several upcoming service changes
To recruit seasonal postal workers
To apologize for a delayed shipment
questions.explanation: 공지는 10월 6일부터 적용되는 우편 요금 인상, 수거 시간 변경, 토요일 창구 시간 단축, 여권 업무 예약제 전환 등 여러 가지 서비스 변경 사항을 안내하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 우체국 폐쇄, 직원 채용, 배송 지연 사과는 본문 내용과 무관합니다.

questions.question: How much more will 20 first-class stamps cost at the new rate than at the current rate?
questions.explanation: 일반 1종 우표 가격이 $0.68에서 $0.73로 인상되어 장당 $0.05 오릅니다. 20장 기준 인상분은 $0.05 × 20 = $1.00이므로 (C)가 정답입니다. (A)는 1장 기준 인상분, (D)는 새 요금 20장 가격($14.60)과 헷갈리도록 만든 함정과 무관한 오답입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about FOREVER stamps?
options: They will be discontinued on October 6.
They remain valid even after rates change.
They can be used only for postcards.
They must be exchanged for new stamps.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 FOREVER 표시가 있는 우표는 향후 요금 변경과 관계없이 계속 유효하다고 명시하고 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 단종, 엽서 전용, 교환 의무에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

questions.question: According to the notice, what will customers need to do to apply for a passport after October 6?
options: Visit on a Saturday morning
Make an appointment in advance
Pay an additional service fee
Submit applications by mail only
questions.explanation: 10월 6일부터 여권 신청은 예약제(by appointment only)로만 접수되며, 웹사이트나 전화로 예약할 수 있다고 안내되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 토요일 방문, 추가 수수료, 우편 접수에 대한 요구 사항은 본문에 없습니다.

Glenfield Post Office
2 Station Road, Glenfield

July 10

Dear Box Holder,

Our records indicate that the six-month rental period for Post Office Box 412 will end on July 31. To keep your box without interruption, please renew by July 24. Renewals received between July 25 and July 31 will be processed with a $10 late-handling charge. If no renewal is received by August 10, the box will be closed, the lock will be reset, and any mail addressed to the box will be returned to senders.

Renewal options are as follows: six months for $56 or twelve months for $102. Payment may be made online at glenfieldpost.gov/boxes, at the retail counter during business hours, or by check mailed to the address above. Please write your box number on all payments.

Customers who renew for twelve months will also receive two months of free package alerts by text message.

Thank you for using our box rental service.

Carl Jensen
Retail Services Supervisor

questions.question: Why was the letter sent?
options: To inform a customer that a package has arrived
To remind a customer to renew a post office box rental
To announce an increase in box rental prices
To notify a customer of a change of address
questions.explanation: 편지는 사서함 412호의 6개월 임대 기간이 7월 31일에 종료되므로 7월 24일까지 갱신할 것을 안내하는 갱신 독려 편지입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 소포 도착 통지, 요금 인상 발표, 주소 변경 통보가 목적이 아닙니다.

questions.question: How much would a customer save by choosing one twelve-month renewal instead of two six-month renewals?
questions.explanation: 6개월 갱신은 $56이므로 두 번 갱신하면 $56 × 2 = $112입니다. 12개월 갱신은 $102이므로 절약액은 $112 − $102 = $10입니다. 따라서 (A)가 정답입니다. 두 요금제를 비교하여 차액을 구하는 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: What will happen if no renewal is received by August 10?
options: The rental fee will be doubled.
The box will be closed and mail returned to senders.
The mail will be forwarded to the customer's home.
The box will be assigned a new number.
questions.explanation: 8월 10일까지 갱신이 접수되지 않으면 사서함이 폐쇄되고 자물쇠가 재설정되며, 해당 사서함으로 온 우편물은 발신인에게 반송된다고 명시되어 있으므로 (B)가 정답입니다. 요금 두 배 부과, 자택 전송, 번호 변경은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What extra benefit is offered with a twelve-month renewal?
options: A discount on postage stamps
A free replacement key
Two months of free text message package alerts
Priority counter service
questions.explanation: 편지 후반부에 12개월 갱신 고객에게는 문자 메시지 소포 알림 서비스 2개월 무료 혜택이 제공된다고 안내되어 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 우표 할인, 무료 열쇠 교체, 창구 우선 서비스는 본문에 없습니다.

BAYPORT–CEDAR ISLAND FERRY
SUMMER SCHEDULE (June 15 – September 7)

Departures from Bayport Pier: 7:00 A.M., 9:30 A.M., 12:00 noon, 2:30 P.M., 5:00 P.M., 7:30 P.M.

The crossing takes 40 minutes. Each ferry departs Cedar Island for the return trip 45 minutes after its arrival there.

Fares: Adults $9 one way, $16 round trip. Children under 12 travel at half the adult one-way fare. Bicycles may be brought aboard for an additional $3 each. Passengers traveling with vehicles must reserve space at least 24 hours in advance at bayportferry.com, as vehicle capacity is limited to twelve cars per crossing.

Notes: Boarding closes five minutes before departure. The 7:30 P.M. sailing does not operate on Sundays. In the event of severe weather, cancellations are posted on the website by 6:00 A.M. Ticket holders on canceled sailings may rebook free of charge or request a full refund within 30 days.

questions.question: What time does the 2:30 P.M. ferry arrive at Cedar Island?
questions.explanation: 운항 시간이 40분이므로 오후 2시 30분에 출발한 페리는 2:30 + 40분 = 오후 3시 10분에 시더 아일랜드에 도착합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. 출발 시각에 소요 시간을 더하는 시간 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: How much does an adult save by buying a round-trip ticket instead of two one-way tickets?
questions.explanation: 성인 편도 요금은 $9이므로 편도 두 번이면 $18입니다. 왕복 요금은 $16이므로 절약액은 $18 − $16 = $2입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다. (C) $3은 자전거 추가 요금과 혼동을 유도하는 오답입니다.

questions.question: What must passengers traveling with a vehicle do?
options: Arrive one hour before departure
Pay double the adult fare
Reserve space at least 24 hours in advance
Travel only on weekday sailings
questions.explanation: 차량 동반 승객은 회당 차량 수용이 12대로 제한되어 있으므로 최소 24시간 전에 웹사이트에서 자리를 예약해야 한다고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 (C)가 정답입니다. 1시간 전 도착, 요금 2배, 평일 한정 탑승 조건은 본문에 없습니다.

Posted October 20

The MV Harbor Star will be withdrawn from service from Monday, November 3, through Friday, November 14, for scheduled engine maintenance. During this period, the smaller vessel MV Gull will operate a reduced timetable of four daily crossings: 8:00 A.M., 11:00 A.M., 2:00 P.M., and 5:00 P.M. from Bayport.

Maplewood Terrace Homeowners Association
Management Office, Building C

February 10

Dear Homeowner,

At its January meeting, the board approved the full replacement of the roofs on Buildings A and B, which inspectors found to be at the end of their service life. The total contracted cost is $180,000. The association's reserve fund will cover $120,000 of this amount. The remaining $60,000 will be collected through a one-time special assessment divided equally among all 120 units.

Accordingly, each unit owner is responsible for a special assessment of $500. Payment may be made in a single payment due by March 31, or in five monthly installments of $100 each, beginning March 1. Owners choosing installments must complete the enclosed payment plan form and return it to the management office by February 25.

Assessments not paid according to either schedule will accrue a late charge of $15 per month. Questions may be directed to the treasurer at treasurer@maplewoodhoa.org.

Sincerely,
Gordon Alves
Board President

The Crestview Community Center, in partnership with Regional Blood Services, will host a blood drive on Friday, May 22, from 10:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. in the main hall.

Who can donate: Donors must be at least 17 years old, weigh at least 50 kilograms, and be in general good health. All donors must present a photo ID at check-in. Individuals who donated whole blood within the past eight weeks are not eligible.

As a thank-you, every donor will receive a voucher for a free beverage and snack at the center's café.

WESTBROOK CONFERENCE CENTER — LOST PROPERTY PROCEDURES

For the convenience of our guests and event organizers, the conference center maintains a lost property service at the security desk in the main lobby.

Reporting and turning in items: Guests who lose an item during an event should report it to the security desk as soon as possible. Anyone who finds an item on the premises is asked to hand it in at the same desk, where it will be logged with the date, location found, and a brief description.

Storage periods: General items are stored for 30 days. Electronics such as laptops, tablets, and phones are kept in a locked safe for 90 days. Items bearing a name badge or business card will trigger an e-mail to the event organizer when contact details are available.

Returning items: Items may be collected in person at any time the building is open. Alternatively, we can ship items at the owner's cost using the courier service of the owner's choice; a handling form must be completed before shipment.

Inquiries: Submit the lost property form at westbrookcc.com/lost. Our team responds to all inquiries within two business days.

options: To explain the center's lost property procedures
To announce the relocation of the security desk

To recruit security staff
questions.explanation: 공지는 컨퍼런스 센터에서 분실물을 신고하고 보관하며 되찾는 절차 전반을 안내하고 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 보안 데스크 이전, 행사 홍보, 직원 채용은 본문 내용이 아닙니다.

30 days

90 days

City of Dorset
12 Civic Square

August 1

Edwin Park
City Clerk

12 Civic Square, Suite 110

September 2

Dear Mr. Felix Arnaud,

Our records show that the operating license for Arnaud Catering (License No. 88231) will expire on September 30. To continue operating legally, you must renew the license before that date.

How to renew: The fastest method is online at dorsetcity.gov/licenses, where payment can be made by card or bank transfer. You may also renew by mail or in person at the Licensing Division. The standard renewal fee is $120. Your renewal must include a current certificate of liability insurance; renewals received without it cannot be processed.

Late renewals: Licenses renewed between October 1 and October 31 are subject to a $30 late penalty in addition to the standard fee. Businesses still unlicensed after October 31 may not operate and are subject to a fine of $100 for each day of operation without a valid license.

If your business has closed or changed ownership, please notify this office in writing so that our records can be updated.

Sincerely,
Nadia Solomon
Licensing Division Manager
